notes.title: Luxury Supermarket Simulator release!!!
notes.notes:
Hello players!

Today is finally the day of the release of the game Luxury Supermarket Simulator in Early Access! We are grateful for your support and great interest.

It is a tradition to announce the update roadmap, but in this case we have to do it a little differently due to the competition. We have very unique ideas for new updates that you will not find in any other supermarket simulator. You will always receive a preview of a new update about 2 weeks before its release. And we plan to release updates at least once a month.

I will be in constant contact with you and will answer every message and email. I really want to develop this game with you. I will not avoid any topics, even the most sensitive ones, I bet 100% on contact with the player.

For the next 2 weeks there is a 15% promotion.

The new release date is March 17.
